method.annotators: AI annotators, not human: two independent Claude subagents with different models (A: Claude Haiku, B: Claude Sonnet), run on 2026-11-25.
method.blinding: Each annotator saw only its own sheet (site, script domain, script URL, runtime technique, page context, stratum) and a shared evidence folder. Neither saw the rule labels (annotation_key.csv), the repository or the other annotator's answers.
method.evidence: The 80 sampled scripts were downloaded once, never executed. 62 of 80 were retrievable; 10 inline scripts and 8 others (HTTP 404, empty answers, timeout) had no file. Each sample also had a neutral card: HTTP status, size, sha256, header comments, referenced domains, API keyword counts and the first 1,500 characters. Annotators searched the files with targeted greps; no web access.
method.instructions: Same definitions as docs/annotation_guide.md (is_fp yes/no/unsure; one purpose among Advertising, Analytics, Anti-fraud/security, Functional, CDN, Unknown; evidence notes).
method.adjudication: The 16 disagreements were adjudicated on 2026-11-26 by a third AI reviewer (OpenAI Codex), using only desaccords.csv, the neutral evidence cards, runtime techniques and public vendor/technical documentation; annotation_key.csv and the automatic labels were not opened before the decisions. Claude Opus independently reviewed the same blinded material in read-only mode as a second opinion. Codex retained uncertainty where a browser-API read could not be linked to a stored or transmitted value: 7 rows were adjudicated yes and 9 unsure; all 16 received a purpose.
method.limits: Static reading of mostly minified code; both original annotators and the AI adjudicators rely partly on vendor recognition, which overlaps with the vendor signatures behind the rule labels; AI reviewers may share errors. The full downloaded scripts were unavailable to the adjudicators, so they used neutral cards and, for a few cases, current public code or documentation. Nine Ad-Shield/Amazon rows remain unsure for fingerprinting because data flow from the observed API value was not established. This is an AI consistency/adjudication check, not human ground truth.
